## Loading

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| error: false

library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(brms)
library(rstan)
library(patchwork)
library(ggside)
library(ggdist)


unnormalize <- function(df, illusion = NULL) {
  if(!is.null(illusion)) df$Illusion_Type <- illusion
  df <- df |> 
    mutate(
      Illusion_Difference = case_when(
        Illusion_Type == "MullerLyer" ~ Illusion_DifferenceZ * (0.46 - 0.04) + 0.04,
        Illusion_Type == "Ebbinghaus" ~ Illusion_DifferenceZ * (0.70 - 0.07) + 0.07,
        Illusion_Type == "VerticalHorizontal" ~ Illusion_DifferenceZ * (0.24 - 0.03) + 0.03,
        .default = NA
      ),
      Illusion_Strength = case_when(
        Illusion_Type == "MullerLyer" ~ Illusion_StrengthZ * 49,
        Illusion_Type == "Ebbinghaus" ~ Illusion_StrengthZ * 2.03,
        Illusion_Type == "VerticalHorizontal" ~ Illusion_StrengthZ * 66.50,
        .default = NA
      )
  )
}
```

## Effects

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

plot_effect_densities <- function(model, datagrid, y_var = "Illusion_Difference",
                                  illusion = "MullerLyer",
                                  rt_range = c(0, 2.5), n_points = 512) {

  palette_diff     <- c("#FF5722", "#FFC107", "#8BC34A")  # Illusion_Difference
  palette_strength <- c("#2196F3", "grey", "#9C27B0")  # Illusion_Strength

  if (y_var == "Illusion_Difference") {
    color_var <- "Illusion_Strength"
    cols   <- palette_strength
    y_cols <- palette_diff
  } else {
    color_var <- "Illusion_Difference"
    cols   <- palette_diff
    y_cols <- palette_strength
  }

  reverse_axes <- identical(color_var, "Illusion_Difference")

  nice_name <- function(var) {
    if (var == "Illusion_Strength") "Illusion Strength"
    else if (var == "Illusion_Difference") "Task Difficulty"
    else gsub("_", " ", var)
  }

  # Step 0: Get the distributional parameters (posterior means) on the datagrid.
  # No posterior draws are needed here: the defective densities of the cogmod
  # choice families are closed-form (LNR) or a fast series (DDM), so we evaluate
  # them directly rather than simulating trials and running a KDE over them
  # (exact, noise-free, and orders of magnitude lighter).
  dpars <- setdiff(model$family$dpars, names(model$formula$pfix))
  grid <- NULL
  for (dp in dpars) {
    r <- as.data.frame(modelbased::estimate_relation(
      model, data = datagrid, predict = dp, ci = NULL
    ))
    if (is.null(grid)) {
      grid <- r[, !names(r) %in% c("Predicted", "SE", "CI_low", "CI_high", "Residuals"), drop = FALSE]
      row.names(grid) <- NULL
    }
    grid[[dp]] <- r$Predicted
  }

  # The model is fitted on the normalized predictors: back-transform them so the
  # facets and the y-axis are labelled in the original units of the illusion.
  grid <- unnormalize(grid, illusion = illusion)
  cell_vars <- c(y_var, color_var)

  # Step 1: Defective density per y_var x color_var x pred_Response, from the
  # model's own density function, dcogmod_<family>(). It is already scaled by
  # the probability of the response, so the area under each curve *is* that
  # response's rate (the two sum to 1 per cell) - i.e. it plays the role the
  # empirical `prop` weighting used to play.
  # (this `y` sign convention - Correct = +, Error = - - is the mirroring
  # rule and must never be touched by axis-order logic below)
  #
  # The dpars go in by name. brms calls the first one `mu` whatever the family,
  # while the density function names it after what it is (nuzero for the LNR,
  # drift for the DDM), so it is renamed to that function's first argument
  # after `x`. The dpars fixed in the formula are passed at their fixed values.
  dens_fun <- get(paste0("d", model$family$name), envir = asNamespace("cogmod"))
  mu_name <- names(formals(dens_fun))[2]
  fixed <- model$formula$pfix   # named list of the fixed values, or NULL
  stopifnot(all(dpars %in% names(grid)))

  rt <- seq(1e-4, max(rt_range) * 2.5, length.out = n_points * 3)
  dx <- rt[2] - rt[1]

  dens_data <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    pars <- setNames(as.list(grid[i, dpars]), sub("^mu$", mu_name, dpars))
    purrr::map_dfr(c(0, 1), function(resp) {
      data.frame(
        grid[i, cell_vars, drop = FALSE],
        pred_Response = factor(resp, levels = c(0, 1)),
        x = rt,
        y = do.call(dens_fun, c(list(rt, response = resp), pars, fixed)),
        row.names = NULL
      )
    })
  })

  # Response rate and mean RT per response, integrated over the full support
  # (before the density is truncated to the plotting window)
  mean_data <- dens_data |>
    group_by(.data[[y_var]], .data[[color_var]], pred_Response) |>
    summarise(
      prop = sum(y) * dx,
      mean_RT = sum(x * y) / sum(y),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(prop > 0.005)

  dens_data <- dens_data |>
    filter(x <= max(rt_range)) |>
    mutate(y = if_else(pred_Response == 0, y, -y))

  color_vals_asc  <- sort(unique(round(dens_data[[color_var]], 2)))
  color_levels_chr <- as.character(color_vals_asc)
  facet_levels <- if (reverse_axes) rev(color_levels_chr) else color_levels_chr

  to_factor <- function(d) {
    mutate(d, !!sym(color_var) := factor(
      as.character(round(.data[[color_var]], 2)),
      levels = facet_levels
    ))
  }
  dens_data <- to_factor(dens_data)
  mean_data <- to_factor(mean_data)

  # Step 2: Row position by rank (decoupled from y's internal sign)
  val_levels_sorted <- sort(unique(round(dens_data[[y_var]], 6)))
  n_levels <- length(val_levels_sorted)
  rank_asc <- seq_len(n_levels)

  pos_for_level <- if (reverse_axes) {
    setNames(rev(rank_asc), as.character(val_levels_sorted))
  } else {
    setNames(rank_asc, as.character(val_levels_sorted))
  }

  scale_factor <- 1.5

  dens_data <- dens_data |>
    mutate(
      y_offset = pos_for_level[as.character(round(.data[[y_var]], 6))],
      y_scaled = y_offset + y * scale_factor
    )

  mean_data <- mean_data |>
    mutate(y_offset = pos_for_level[as.character(round(.data[[y_var]], 6))])

  break_pos <- pos_for_level[as.character(val_levels_sorted)]
  ord <- order(break_pos)
  breaks_pos <- break_pos[ord]          # ascending position: bottom -> top of panel
  breaks_val <- val_levels_sorted[ord]  # the true value sitting at each position

  # Step 2b: Baseline lines colored by the y_var gradient (instead of flat grey)
  y_ramp <- scales::colour_ramp(y_cols)
  hline_colors <- y_ramp(scales::rescale(breaks_val, from = range(val_levels_sorted)))
  hline_data <- tibble(y = breaks_pos, line_col = hline_colors)

  # Step 3: Plot
  p <- dens_data |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = x,
      y = y_scaled,
      group = interaction(.data[[y_var]], .data[[color_var]], pred_Response),
      color = as.factor(.data[[color_var]]),
      fill = factor(pred_Response)
    )) +
    geom_hline(
      data = hline_data,
      aes(yintercept = y, color = I(line_col)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1.3,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = y_offset, ymax = y_scaled),
      alpha = 0.4,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(
      data = mean_data,
      aes(x = mean_RT, y = y_offset, fill = pred_Response),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21, size = 3, color = "white", stroke = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pos, labels = round(breaks_val, 2)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(cols, color_levels_chr)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("0" = "#43A047", "1" = "#F44336"),
      labels = c("0" = "Correct", "1" = "Error")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "RT",
      y = nice_name(y_var),
      color = nice_name(color_var),
      fill = "Response"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = rt_range) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(.data[[color_var]]),
      labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste0(nice_name(color_var), " = ", x))
    )

  p
}

plot_effect_densities(
  model = gam,
  datagrid = insight::get_datagrid(gam, length = c(Illusion_DifferenceZ = 8, Illusion_StrengthZ = 3)),
  y_var = "Illusion_Difference"
)
plot_effect_densities(
  model = gam,
  datagrid = insight::get_datagrid(gam, length = c(Illusion_DifferenceZ = 3, Illusion_StrengthZ = 9)),
  y_var = "Illusion_Strength"
)
```


## Parameters

### Curves

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

datagrid <- insight::get_datagrid(gam, length = c(Illusion_DifferenceZ = 5, Illusion_StrengthZ = 30))
pred <- estimate_prediction(gam, data = datagrid, centrality = "mean", 
                            iterations = 2500, keep_iterations = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Parameter = Component, Type = "GAM") |> 
  select(-Component, -Row) |> 
  mutate(Parameter = ifelse(Parameter == "response", "Error Rate", "Mean RT"))

# Only keep iterations of correct responses to compute mean
iters_rt <- data.frame(select(pred[pred$Parameter == "Mean RT", ], starts_with("iter_")))
iters_rt[data.frame(select(pred[pred$Parameter == "Error Rate", ], starts_with("iter_"))) == 1] <- NA
pred[pred$Parameter == "Mean RT", "Predicted"] <- rowMeans(iters_rt, na.rm = TRUE)
# Remove mean RTs when only a few correct trials as it's noisy 
pred[pred$Parameter == "Mean RT", "Predicted"][pred[pred$Parameter == "Error Rate", "Predicted"] > 0.9] <- NA
 
pred <- select(pred, -starts_with("iter_"))

params <- find_auxiliary(gam)
params <- c("mu", params[!params %in% c("poutlier")])
for(p in params) {
  pred <- rbind(
    pred,
    estimate_relation(gam, data = datagrid, predict = p) |> 
      mutate(Parameter = p, Type = "GAM")
  )
}
pred <- pred |> 
  mutate(Parameter = fct_relevel(Parameter, c("Error Rate", "Mean RT"))) |> 
  # , "Nu_Correct", "Nu_Error", "NDT", "Sigma_Correct", "Sigma_Error"))) |>
  unnormalize(illusion = "MullerLyer") 


layout <- matrix(c(
  rep(1, 5), rep(2, 5),  # Column 1 (Left): 5 units for the main outcomes
  rep(3, 2),             # Column 2 (Right): 2 units each for remaining 5
  rep(4, 2),
  rep(5, 2),
  rep(6, 2),
  rep(7, 2)
), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)

pred |> 
  mutate(Illusion_Difference = as.factor(Illusion_Difference)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Illusion_Strength, y = Predicted)) +
  # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, group = Illusion_Difference), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(color = Illusion_Difference, group = interaction(Type, Illusion_Difference), linetype = Type),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(c("#FF5722", "#FFC107", "#8BC34A", "#4CAF50"))(length(unique(pred$Illusion_Difference)))
    ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("GAM" = "solid", "LM" = "dashed")) +
  # facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free_y") +
  ggh4x::facet_manual(vars(Parameter), design = layout, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Heatmaps


```{r}
datagrid <- insight::get_datagrid(gam, by = list(Illusion_DifferenceZ = seq(0, 1, length.out=40),
                                                            Illusion_StrengthZ = seq(-1, 1, length.out=40)))

pred_heatmap <- rbind(
  estimate_prediction(gam, data = datagrid, predict = "mu") |> 
      mutate(Parameter = "Nu_Correct", Type = "GAM"),
  estimate_prediction(gam, data = datagrid, predict = "nuone") |> 
      mutate(Parameter = "Nu_Error", Type = "GAM"),
  estimate_prediction(gam, data = datagrid, predict = "sigmazero") |>
      mutate(Parameter = "Sigma_Correct", Type = "GAM"),
    estimate_prediction(gam, data = datagrid, predict = "sigmaone") |>
      mutate(Parameter = "Sigma_Error", Type = "GAM"),
    estimate_prediction(gam, data = datagrid, predict = "ndt") |>
      mutate(Parameter = "NDT", Type = "GAM")
) |> 
  unnormalize(illusion = "MullerLyer") 

# Split data by Parameter and generate individual plots
plot_list <- pred_heatmap |> 
  group_split(Parameter) |> 
  map(function(df) {
    param_name <- unique(df$Parameter)
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = Illusion_Strength, y = Illusion_Difference)) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = Predicted)) +
      geom_contour(aes(z = Predicted), color = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5, bins = 20) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = -30, xmax = 30, ymin = 0.1, ymax = 0.4, 
               fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dotted") +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(x = "Illusion Strength", y = "Illusion Difference", fill = NULL, title = param_name) +
      theme_minimal()
  })

wrap_plots(plot_list)
```

#### Transformation Exploration

```{r}
pred_heatmap |> 
  mutate(Illusion_Strength_signedlog = sign(Illusion_Strength) * log1p(abs(Illusion_Strength))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Illusion_Strength_signedlog, y = Illusion_Difference, z = Predicted)) +
  geom_contour_filled(bins = 20) +
  geom_contour(color = "white", alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4, bins = 20) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(x = "Transformed Illusion Strength (signed-log)", y = "Illusion Difference", fill = "Nu") +
  facet_wrap(~Parameter) +
  theme_minimal()
```
